data.headline: USGO received Nasdaq notice over Audit Committee composition

claims.text: On August 27, 2026, the Company received written notice from Nasdaq’s Listing Qualifications Department.

citation.quote: On August 27, 2026, the Company received written notice from Nasdaq’s Listing Qualifications Department

claims.text: The notice followed Ms. Bukacheva’s resignation and her no longer serving on the Board and Audit Committee.

citation.quote: as a result of Ms. Bukacheva’s resignation and no longer serving as a member of the Board and the Audit Committee

claims.text: Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2) requires the Audit Committee to consist of at least three members who are independent directors.

citation.quote: Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2) requires the Audit Committee to consist of at least three members, each of whom is an independent director under the Nasdaq Listing Rules

claims.text: The filing says the notice has no immediate effect on the Company’s Nasdaq listing, subject to compliance with the listing rules.

citation.quote: The foregoing has no immediate effect on the Company’s Nasdaq listing, subject to compliance with the listing rules.

claims.text: The company says many regulations require permits or licenses and that inability to obtain them would adversely affect exploration, development and operation activities.

citation.quote: Many of the regulations require permits or licenses to be obtained and the filing of Notices of Intent and Plans of Operations, the absence of which or inability to obtain will adversely affect the ability for us to conduct our exploration, development and operation activities.
